Hello! I’m Brian, and I’ve submitted a Lean formalization of Written on the Wall II Conjecture 146 for review:

https://github.com/google-deepmind/formal-conjectures/pull/4505

The PR preserves the existing theorem statement, replaces its placeholder with a Lean 4 proof, and includes the supporting graph-metric and exceptional-case lemmas. The CLA and automated checks are complete.

I’d be grateful for any guidance on repository conventions, proof organization, or changes needed for review. Thank you for maintaining Formal Conjectures.
Great! I added comments in the PR
